text: Mind the circles on the floor. One of them still remembers what it was drawn for.
Elske Barrow. I hold the top of this tower, which mostly means I hold the keys to it.
SS rank, once. These days I'd rather read about monsters than set them on fire.
Not today. The trainers in the court below take novices: black fire, white light, and the summoners' circles.
Come back with some rank on your card and we'll see what you can hold without burning your hands.
The city's college of magic: the library, the lecture hall, the circles, and this tower over all of it.
Everything that comes out of a gate leaves a trace. We study the traces, so the Guild knows what it's facing.
